title: Add link to end of first paragraph on each privacy notice page
body:
Legal wants us to add a small bit of copy on the end of the first paragraph of each privacy notice page. 

Copydocs can be found here:

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B3hNyKyLEnE6clUxQndBME5uRXM
author: Participant 1
scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
